payload.title: No step outside the cycle creates a judgment request group: dispatch_judges_for_sample has one production call site in cycle.py, the judge CLI verb has only replay, and agent-invocations request mints a single request without the seat plan, the tier-0 gate, the method receipt or the consensus link
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:401 (dispatch_judges_for_sample, the function that mints the seats of a sample)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cycle.py:2123-2133 (route_judgment_sample and then dispatch_judges_for_sample per leg: the only production call site)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cli.py:1527-1533 (the judge subcommand defines replay and nothing else)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cli.py:2344-2347 (agent-invocations request takes one target agent, one role and one prompt file)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/cli.py:5656-5671 (the verb calls create_agent_invocation_request once, as an operator mint, with no seat plan)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_invocations.py:1367-1388 (the dispatch records a context hash and a prompt hash and verifies them together)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/agent_invocations.py:6227-6235 (submit-result refuses an answer whose context_hash or prompt_hash differs from the request's recorded binding)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md one owner per concept and make it automatic (tier 2): the judgment lane has one dispatcher, and every entry point that needs a judgment group must reach it instead of rebuilding its parts
payload.notes: A step-by-step run has no way to turn a sampled finding into the judge seats the consensus and promotion path reads: judge replay only replays a gold corpus, and agent-invocations request creates one request from an operator prompt file with none of the seat plan, tier-0 gate, method receipt or anchor and consensus link that dispatch_judges_for_sample adds, while submit-result accepts an answer only if it carries the context_hash and prompt_hash of the request the kernel rendered. The judgment lane is therefore reachable only through the cycle's judge phase. Close condition: One CLI wrapper over dispatch_judges_for_sample (no second dispatcher) mints the judgment group for a given sample or finding, or a documented rule states that the cycle's judge phase is the only entry; a test pins whichever is chosen (the wrapper mints the same seats and receipt fields as the cycle for one fixture sample, or the rule text is pinned by a test). Verified at origin/main db10640f6.
